title: Profile language card says the interface language is chosen separately, but it and the globe menu are the same setting
body:
## Summary

The **Language** card on the profile page (Account → Profile) tells the user that it only sets the language of notifications and messages, and that the interface language is a separate setting in the globe menu:

> The language used for notifications and messages sent to you. The interface language is chosen separately, from the globe menu.

(zh-Hans: 「发送给您的通知和消息所使用的语言。界面语言另行设置,在地球图标菜单中切换。」)

That is no longer true. The two controls are one setting (`sys_user.locale`), and changing either changes both. A user who follows the text and picks "English" only for their emails gets the whole console switched to English.

## Steps to reproduce

Console UI in Simplified Chinese, `sys_user.locale = null`.

1. Open `/_console/apps/com.objectstack.account/component/account/profile_card`.
2. In **语言 → 首选语言** pick **English**, click **保存**.
   - Result: the whole console switches to English at once (`<html lang="en">`, tab title "Account — ObjectOS", navigation, every app). `GET /api/v1/auth/me/localization` returns `locale: "en"`; `localStorage` `objectui-locale` and `objectui-locale-seed` are `en`.
3. Open the account menu → **Language** → **简体中文**.
   - Result: the console is Chinese again and `GET /api/v1/data/sys_user/<id>` now shows `locale: "zh-Hans"`, i.e. the globe menu wrote the very column the card says it does not touch. The profile card's select shows 简体中文.

## Expected

The card describes what the control does: one language setting for the interface and for notifications/messages, the same one as the globe menu.

## Where

`main` still has the old wording, although the behaviour was unified on purpose:

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useUserLocale.ts` (objectui#10059): "For a signed-in user `sys_user.locale` is the ONLY decider … Both controls write the same column through the same adapter … changing the language in either place changes it in both".
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ProfilePage.tsx`
  - line 721, `profile.language.description` default text: "… The interface language is chosen separately, from the globe menu."
  - lines ~570–579, the component comment: "Saving here therefore does NOT call `changeLanguage`, and switching the UI language from the globe menu does NOT write this column."
- `profile.language.description` in the locale files (`en`, `zh-Hans`, and the others) carries the same sentence.

Small extra in the zh-Hans string: it uses a half-width comma (「另行设置,在」) inside a Chinese sentence.

## Environment

`@objectstack/*` 18.6.0, console build `958ee03594`; the wording was re-checked on `main` today (2026-11-24).
